It is a single-subject photograph and its caption names him outright, so there is no positional reasoning to do. He is sitting in the training room in a Toppers practice vest, laughing, looking off camera; the head is about 115 pixels across, four times anything else this block has produced, because the frame is a half-column portrait rather than a face in a group. The article dates it to his senior season, 1988-89, which is the year the archive records him in student government. The other two frames on the spread are an action shot driving up the court and a handshake receiving the Western Kentucky Invitational MVP award; this one shows the face best.
caption_quote: Tying his shoes, senior Brett McNeal from Minneapolis, Minn., gets ready for practice
id_note: IDENTIFICATION BY NAME, AND THE ARCHIVE'S OWN RECORD OF HIM IS ITSELF QUALIFIED. The worklist entry reads 'Congress award nominee (membership not independently confirmed)', so the archive does not claim he sat in Congress, only that he was nominated for an award by it. Nothing in the Talisman mentions student government. What is certain is the face and the man: the books know one Brett McNeal, indexed in 1987 as "McNeal, Brett Lavone 218, 221, 222, 229" and in 1989 at pp. 292, 293, 327 and 330, all basketball; he is the guard from Minneapolis who was the fourth leading scorer in Western's history and graduated in May 1989 in speech communication. If the editor decides the award nomination is not membership, this crop should come out with the row, not stay behind it.

name: Lisa Kaufman
why: 1987 Talisman, printed p. 160, the first of the two Alpha Delta Pi group photographs, cropped to the last of the five in the middle row. Thirteen women stand in three clean tiers of four, five and four and the caption names thirteen in exactly that order: FRONT ROW Gina Black, Andrea Newby, Alicia Sells, Laura Faughn; SECOND ROW Karen Deluca, Rebecca Melton, Amy Hoopingarner, Kathy Crumby, Lisa Kaufman; BACK ROW Amy Biggs, Doria Wilson, Karen Harris, Jennifer Hayden. Counting the tiers gives four in front, five in the middle and four behind, which fits the caption one for one; Kaufman is the fifth and last of the middle row, at the right-hand edge. Everyone in the frame is a woman so there is no sex test, but the counts are exact and the tiers separate cleanly. This is an ARCHIVE.ORG copy of the volume, scanned at 3282 pixels to the page against TopSCHOLAR's 880, which is why the face comes out 185 pixels across from a thirteen-person group.
caption_quote: SECOND ROW: Karen Deluca, Rebecca Melton, Amy Hoopingarner, Kathy Crumby, Lisa Kaufman
id_note: The 1987 index reads "Kaufman, Lisa G. 160" and the 1988 index "Kaufman, Lisa 270", both Alpha Delta Pi, and there is no other Lisa Kaufman in the 1987 to 1993 volumes; the only other Kaufmans are Andy Kaufman the comedian and a Scott Kauffman. She has no class portrait in any volume. Her SGA year is 1988-89 and these are the volumes for 1986-87 and 1987-88, so the identification rests on the name and the overlap of years, not on a caption tying her to student government.

name: Becky Shirley
why: 1987 Talisman, printed p. 343, the sophomore portrait grid, row 6 cell 2. The page prints forty-two portraits, six across and seven down, with each row's six names set as one block in the right-hand margin in alphabetical order. Row six reads CLARENCE SHIRLEY, REBEKAH SHIRLEY, PAMELA SHOOK, TOMMY SHRIVER, RHONDA SIDEBOTTOM, JAMES SMITH, which requires man, woman, woman, man, woman, man, and the row shows exactly that. The rows either side confirm the mapping: row five reads Wendell Sears, Stephen Seaton, Sandra Sendelbach, Naheed Shafi, Teresa Shanks, Marya Shelton, two men then four women, and the picture agrees; row seven reads Jason Smith, Lori Smith, Mark Smith, Terri Smith, Jimmy Smothers, Jodi Sobotka, alternating man and woman, and the picture agrees. She is the second cell of row six, a studio headshot facing the camera. This is the ARCHIVE.ORG copy of the volume at 3282 pixels to the page, so the crop is 360 by 435 with no upscaling, the best portrait this block has recovered.
caption_quote: REBEKAH SHIRLEY, Manhattan, Kan.
id_note: The volume itself equates Rebekah and Becky, which is what makes this safe. The 1987 back index reads "Shirley, Rebekah Ann 189, 343", one woman on two pages: p. 343 is this grid cell, printed REBEKAH SHIRLEY, and p. 189 is a group photograph whose caption reads "FRONT ROW: Kelly Thurmond, Lisa Hurt, Becky Shirley, Cindy Herbert, Kim Martin". The only other Shirley in the volume is Clarence Edward Shirley, indexed at p. 343 alone. She served in SGA in 1988-89 and was a sophomore in 1986-87, which fits.
